record.paper_title: Some open problems on best approximation in normed linear spaces
record.original_question: Characterize those Banach spaces E for which there is no closed linear subspace G of finite codimension n < infinity such that some point x in E \ G has no best approximation in G, that is, P_G(x) = emptyset. Equivalently, characterize the Banach spaces E for which no such finite-codimensional subspace G admits a nonzero vector z outside G satisfying ||z - g|| >= ||z|| for every g in G.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E$ be a (real or complex) Banach space. For a closed linear subspace $G \subseteq E$ and a point $x \in E$, define the set of best approximations of $x$ in $G$ by
$$P_G(x) = \{g_0 \in G : \|x - g_0\| = \inf_{g \in G} \|x - g\|\}.$$
Say that $E$ has property $(\star)$ if for every closed linear subspace $G \subseteq E$ of finite codimension $n < \infty$ and every $x \in E \setminus G$, the set $P_G(x)$ is nonempty; equivalently, $E$ has property $(\star)$ if there do not exist a closed linear subspace $G \subseteq E$ of finite codimension and a vector $z \in E \setminus \{0\}$ with $z \notin G$ satisfying
$$\|z - g\| \geq \|z\| \quad \text{for every } g \in G.$$
Characterize the class of Banach spaces $E$ enjoying property $(\star)$.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete intrinsic characterization of Banach spaces in which every finite-codimensional closed subspace is proximinal does not appear in the literature. Partial results are known: by a theorem of Garkavi/Klee, a subspace of finite codimension is proximinal iff every functional in its annihilator attains its norm, and reflexive spaces trivially satisfy the property. Recent work (e.g., Read 2013/Rmoutil) exhibits Banach spaces with no proximinal subspaces of codimension 2, showing the question is delicate. No published full characterization was found.

status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a Banach space having no proximinal subspaces of finite codimension greater than 1.
status_evidence.claim: The existence/nonexistence of proximinal finite-codimensional subspaces is subtle; no general characterization is available.

status_evidence.title: On proximinality of subspaces and lineability of norm-attaining functionals
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of when finite codimensional subspaces are proximinal in terms of norm attainment.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate finite-codimensional proximinality, indicating the characterization problem remains active.
